2608.05778.title: When Do Prompt-Side Agent Playbooks Transfer? Accuracy, Cost, and Runtime Shift in Agent Deployment
2608.05778.paper_summary: Prompt-side playbooks can improve tool-using language agents without retraining, but their portability beyond the source setting is unclear. We study frozen playbook transfer under a shared distill--validate--transfer protocol. On ALFWorld, transfer is beneficial under controlled greedy decoding and, in one near-budget-matched comparison, distilled guidance outperforms five fixed demonstrations. On TAU2-Bench, a prespecified aggregate contrast supports a modest average matched-domain advantage, but global Holm correction retains only one of 135 route-level effects; the remaining grid provides descriptive evidence of compatibility-sensitive heterogeneity. On XBench-DeepSearch, one artifact--runtime pairing preserves useful first-try heuristics while producing repeated queries, delayed stopping, and substantial cost inflation after a context-runtime shift. Across benchmarks, transferred and target-derived playbooks both require target-side validation of success, termination, protocol compatibility, and cost. Frozen transfer is therefore a conditional cold-start option, not a reuse-by-default strategy or a universally preferable alternative to target-side redistillation.
2608.05778.paper_summary_zh: 提示側的劇本可以在不重新訓練的情況下改善使用工具的語言代理，但其在源設置之外的可攜性尚不明確。<lb/>我們在共享的蒸餾--驗證--轉移協議下研究凍結劇本的轉移。<lb/>在ALFWorld上，在受控的貪婪解碼下，轉移是有利的，並且在一次接近預算匹配的比較中，蒸餾指導的表現超過了五個固定示範。<lb/>在TAU2-Bench上，預先指定的聚合對比支持適度的平均匹配領域優勢，但全球Holm校正僅保留了135個路徑級效果中的一個；其餘的網格提供了兼容性敏感異質性的描述性證據。<lb/>在XBench-DeepSearch上，一個工件--運行時配對保留了有用的首次嘗試啟發式，同時產生重複查詢、延遲停止以及在上下文-運行時轉移後的顯著成本膨脹。<lb/>在各個基準中，轉移的和目標衍生的劇本都需要對成功、終止、協議兼容性和成本進行目標側驗證。<lb/>因此，凍結轉移是一種有條件的冷啟動選項，而不是默認的重用策略或普遍可取的替代方案以進行目標側的重新蒸餾。
